title: Portfolio sources manifest
description: Last-synced git fingerprints for each portfolio source repo. Written by `drift sync` (`scripts/check-drift.js`).

firstCommitProvisional.description: True while firstCommit values are provisional estimates. Set to false after a real `drift sync`.

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO date of the last `drift sync` run (YYYY-MM-DD).

sources.description: Keyed by project slug (matches ProjectSlug in types.ts).

SyncedSource.description: Git fingerprint for one source repo. All fields optional — populated incrementally by check-drift.js. Property order matches FINGERPRINT_FIELDS in check-drift.js so Object.keys() derivation preserves field-drift display order.

head.description: Short SHA of HEAD at last sync.

measuredRef.description: Git ref the fingerprint was measured against (resolved default branch, e.g. 'main', or 'HEAD' when no default branch could be resolved). Metadata only; excluded from drift comparison via DRIFT_SKIP_FIELDS.

lastCommit.description: ISO date of the most recent commit.

firstCommit.description: ISO date of the root commit (project inception).

languages.description: Languages present in the repo, ordered by file count. Advisory only — language tags are hand-curated.

linesOfCode.description: Total lines across tracked source files, all authors.

linesAddedAll.description: Lines added by all authors, lifetime.

linesRemovedAll.description: Lines removed by all authors, lifetime.

linesAddedRecent.description: Lines added by Jason, trailing 4 weeks.

linesRemovedRecent.description: Lines removed by Jason, trailing 4 weeks.

linesAddedRecentAll.description: Lines added by all authors, trailing 4 weeks.

linesRemovedRecentAll.description: Lines removed by all authors, trailing 4 weeks.

remote.description: HTTPS URL of the primary git remote (git remote get-url origin), normalised from any SSH form. Used as the default repoUrl for un-authored projects.

companionRemotes.description: HTTPS URLs of companion repositories, in tracked topology order.

runtime.description: Runtime identity strings detected by the dependency-manifest parser (e.g. 'bun', 'deno', 'node', 'python', 'go'). Keys match RUNTIME_TAGS in tag-taxonomy.js.

database.description: Database package identities detected by the dependency-manifest parser (e.g. 'pg', '@supabase/supabase-js'). Keys match DATABASE_TAGS in tag-taxonomy.js.

framework.description: Framework package identities detected by the dependency-manifest parser (e.g. 'svelte', '@sveltejs/kit', 'react'). Keys match FRAMEWORK_TAGS in tag-taxonomy.js.
